hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */frontend/src/*.ts|*/frontend/src/*.tsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" || { echo "frontend へ移動できません" >&2; exit 2; }; npx prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null || { echo "prettier に失敗: $f" >&2; exit 2; }; npx eslint --fix "$f" >&2 || { echo "eslint --fix 後も error が残っています: $f" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; }
